data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 晚宴幕间的独处
data.description: 晚宴厅外的安静壁龛，阳乃穿墨蓝缎面西装和象牙色高领衬衫，侧坐在绒椅扶手边。她摘下一枚耳夹放进掌心，望着镜面之外的走廊，营业式笑容终于松下来；暖灯只照亮她与手中小小的银色光点。
data.action: 摘下耳夹放在掌心，坐着望向安静走廊。
data.mood: 名媛伪装、戴着面具起舞
data.promptProse: Beyond the ballroom, Haruno Yukinoshita removes a silver clip-on earring into her open palm while seated in the upholstered alcove. Midnight-blue satin jacket and wide-leg trousers frame an ivory high-neck blouse as her social smile eases into a thoughtful exhale. The medium view follows a deserted corridor beyond the seat. Amber wall light illuminates her black bob, tired eyes and metal glint, with darker upholstery folds behind her hands.
